verdict.rationale: Runloop is an API platform, so a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question to ask of it. However, the probe found 404s at every common OpenAPI/Swagger path, and no documentation mentions a published spec. The llms.txt file, markdown docs, SDKs, MCP server and Cursor rule files are adjacent AI-context features, not an OpenAPI-equivalent spec, so they earn no credit here.
